headline: Tabled vote on Community Preservation Committee representative and authorized Chair Gomes as board signatory.
summary: The board introduced two new members, heard a presentation on the Community Preservation Committee, and tabled the vote on naming a Planning Board representative to that committee until August 18, 2026. The board also authorized George Gomes to sign documents as Chair and approved the May 26, 2026 meeting minutes as amended.
decisions: Tabled the vote for a Planning Board representative to the Community Preservation Committee to the August 18, 2026 meeting; motion carried unanimously (7-0).
Authorized George Gomes as Chair of the Beverly Planning Board as the Planning Board signatory; motion carried (6-0-1, Gomes abstained).
Approved the May 26, 2026 meeting minutes, as amended; motion carried (6-0-1, Vigorito abstained).
